title: Declining greenness under the rapid expansion of the wildland–urban interface on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
title_zh: 青藏高原城乡交错带快速扩张下的绿地衰退现象
title_primary: 青藏高原城乡交错带快速扩张下的绿地衰退现象
title_secondary: Declining greenness under the rapid expansion of the wildland–urban interface on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
authors: Rui Xiao, Yuhan Zhang, Tianjing Wu, Sinuo Xu, Kai Yan 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The wildland–urban interface (WUI) refers to zones where buildings intersect with undeveloped wildland vegetation, and identifying its ecological effects is crucial for understanding human–environment conflicts in relation to landscapes. Current WUI assessments have focused primarily on areas with high-density human activity in developed countries, with limited evidence of vegetation degradation in ecologically vulnerable regions with rapid increases in human activity, e.g., the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau (QTP). We mapped the WUI at a 100-m resolution from 2000 to 2020 on the QTP and quantified vegetation greenness degradation within WUI expansion areas based on the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), leaf area index (LAI) and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF), using propensity score matching (PSM) to control for environmental covariate bias and a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach to eliminate background temporal trends, thereby quantifying the net suppressive effect of WUI expansion on vegetation.The results revealed that the WUI area expanded by 48% over the 20-year period, and the expansion was concentrated mainly at the western, southern, southeastern, and eastern margins of the QTP. Urban expansion had a mean total contribution of 89.6% to WUI expansion, approximately 9 times that of wildland. LAI degradation was 11.57%, NDVI degradation was 2.48%, and SIF degradation was 2.06%; all three indicators exhibited consistent degradation directions, confirming that the impact of WUI expansion on vegetation is dominated by leaf area loss and canopy structural simplification. Direct land conversion is the primary driver of LAI degradation, which proceeds through multiple pathways including direct clearing, landscape reorganisation with fragmentation amplification, and the concentration of grazing pressure.
abstract_zh: 城乡交错带（WUI）指建筑物与未开发野生植被相交的区域，识别其生态效应对于理解人类与环境的景观冲突至关重要。当前WUI评估主要聚焦于发达国家高密度人类活动区域，而对生态脆弱且人类活动快速增加地区（如青藏高原）的植被退化证据有限。本研究以100米分辨率绘制了2000至2020年青藏高原WUI分布图，并基于归一化植被指数（NDVI）、叶面积指数（LAI）和太阳诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）量化了WUI扩张区域内的植被绿度退化，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）控制环境协变量偏差，并运用双重差分（DiD）方法消除背景时间趋势，从而量化WUI扩张对植被的净抑制作用。结果表明，20年间WUI面积扩张了48%，扩张主要集中在青藏高原西部、南部、东南部和东部边缘。城市扩张对WUI扩张的平均总贡献率为89.6%，约为野生植被扩张贡献的9倍。LAI退化率为11.57%，NDVI退化率为2.48%，SIF退化率为2.06%；三项指标均呈现一致的退化方向，证实WUI扩张对植被的影响以叶面积损失和冠层结构简化为主要特征。直接土地转换是LAI退化的主要驱动因素，其作用通过多种途径实现，包括直接清除、伴随破碎化放大的景观重组以及放牧压力的集中化。

title: The Political Economy of Gender Equality
title_zh: 性别平等的政治经济学
title_primary: 性别平等的政治经济学
title_secondary: The Political Economy of Gender Equality
authors: Siwan Anderson
official: 官方在线 2025-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Political institutions have long been dominated by men, and the majority still are. These institutions, in turn, have placed restrictions on the rights and freedoms of women and girls. Progress has been made in the battle for equality, but inequities persist. The first part of this paper discusses the motivations for male leadership to grant women liberties. The second part flips the perspective and considers women's own participation in the political processes that design and uphold their rights. Innovative research in political economy from both of these perspectives continues to grow, and there remain many exciting possibilities for future research.
abstract_zh: 政治制度长期以来由男性主导，至今多数仍如此。这些制度反过来限制了女性及女孩的权利与自由。在争取平等的斗争中虽已取得进展，但不平等现象依然存在。本文第一部分探讨男性领导层授予女性自由的动机。第二部分转换视角，考虑女性自身在设计和维护其权利的政治进程中的参与。从这两个角度出发的政治经济学创新研究持续增长，未来研究仍有许多令人振奋的可能性。

title: Toxic Managers, Firm Productivity, and Worker Well-Being: Evidence from Bangladeshi Garment Factories
title_zh: 有毒管理者、企业生产率与工人福祉：来自孟加拉国服装厂的证据
title_primary: 有毒管理者、企业生产率与工人福祉：来自孟加拉国服装厂的证据
title_secondary: Toxic Managers, Firm Productivity, and Worker Well-Being: Evidence from Bangladeshi Garment Factories
authors: Paula Lopez-Pena, M. Kamruzzaman Mozumder, Atonu Rabbani, Christopher Woodruff
official: 官方在线 2025-02-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many managers adopt ‘toxic’ behaviors that create hostile work environments. How to prevent these behaviors remains unknown. We implemented CBT-oriented skills training for Bangladeshi garment factory supervisors, targeting behaviors that fuel hostility and aggression. Because psychologists delivering the training provided role models for respectful communication, by demonstrating concern for trainees, we compare treatment to both an active control group that received health advice from physicians and to pure control. Both interventions improved productivity, but only health training reduced toxic behaviors. Our results emphasize the need for active control groups and suggest that showing concern for managers may reduce aggressive behaviors.
abstract_zh: 许多管理者采取“有毒”行为，营造出充满敌意的工作环境。如何预防这些行为仍属未知。我们对孟加拉国服装厂主管实施了以认知行为疗法为导向的技能培训，针对助长敌意和攻击性的行为。由于提供培训的心理学家通过展现对学员的关怀，为尊重性沟通树立了榜样，我们将治疗组与接受医生健康建议的积极对照组及纯对照组进行比较。两种干预均提升了生产力，但只有健康培训减少了有毒行为。我们的结果强调了积极对照组的重要性，并表明对管理者展现关怀可能减少攻击性行为。

title: DP20891 Who Gets Hired? The Strength of Weak Ties and the Signaling of Strong Ties
title_zh: 谁被录用？弱关系的力量与强关系的信号传递
title_primary: 谁被录用？弱关系的力量与强关系的信号传递
title_secondary: DP20891 Who Gets Hired? The Strength of Weak Ties and the Signaling of Strong Ties
authors: Shahir Safi, Yves Zenou
official: 官方在线 2025-12-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents a model of referrals in which strong ties serve as a signaling mechanism, allowing employees to convey private information about referred workers. Matching occurs through three channels: strong ties (partially informative), weak ties (uninformative but frictionless), and formal screening in the market (fully informative but frictional). Low-skill workers use weak ties to avoid revealing their type, helping reconcile two stylized facts: Granovetter1973's strength of weak ties and the prevalence of referrals in low-skill jobs. The model also reveals a complementarity between weak and strong ties: conditional on having a strong-tie offer, returns to weak ties are positive and increasing in worker skill.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个推荐模型，其中强关系作为信号机制，使员工能够传递关于被推荐工人的私人信息。匹配通过三种渠道发生：强关系（部分信息性）、弱关系（无信息但无摩擦）以及市场中的正式筛选（完全信息但有摩擦）。低技能工人利用弱关系以避免暴露自身类型，这有助于调和两个典型事实：格兰诺维特1973年提出的“弱关系的力量”以及低技能工作中推荐现象的普遍性。模型还揭示了弱关系与强关系之间的互补性：在拥有强关系机会的条件下，弱关系的回报为正，并随工人技能水平提高而增加。

title: 习近平经济思想研究丨中国特色的区域协调发展道路:理论意涵与实践路径
title_zh: 习近平经济思想研究丨中国特色的区域协调发展道路:理论意涵与实践路径
title_primary: 习近平经济思想研究丨中国特色的区域协调发展道路:理论意涵与实践路径
authors: 魏后凯
official: 官方发布 2026-08-24 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 区域发展不平衡是发展中大国普遍面临的问题。如何在不断缩小与发达国家之间差距的同时，有效破解国内区域发展不平衡问题，实现高水平区域协调发展，是摆在我们面前的一大世界性难题，也是中国共产党人必须回答的时代之问。针对这一时代之问，习近平总书记从中国国情和实际出发，发表了一系列关于区域协调发展的重要论述，深刻揭示了区域经济演变规律，科学回答了中国区域协调发展中的重大理论和现实问题，创新提出了在发展中促进相对平衡、区域协调发展一盘棋等新思想、新观点、新论断，并推动实施了区域重大战略和区域协调发展战略，形成一个完整的理论体系，丰富和发展了世界区域经济理论，为全方位推动区域协调发展、走中国特色区域协调发展道路提供了根本遵循。本文在阐述新时代区域协调发展科学内涵的基础上，深入考察了中国特色区域协调发展道路的理论意涵，并从完善战略体系、机制体系和政策体系三维视角提出了中国特色区域协调发展道路的实践路径。

title: LIFE-CYCLE INEQUALITY: BLACKS AND WHITES DIFFERENTIALS IN LIFE EXPECTANCY, SAVINGS, INCOME, AND CONSUMPTION
title_zh: 生命周期不平等：黑人与白人在预期寿命、储蓄、收入和消费上的差异
title_primary: 生命周期不平等：黑人与白人在预期寿命、储蓄、收入和消费上的差异
title_secondary: LIFE-CYCLE INEQUALITY: BLACKS AND WHITES DIFFERENTIALS IN LIFE EXPECTANCY, SAVINGS, INCOME, AND CONSUMPTION
authors: Giacomo De Giorgi, Luca Gambetti, Costanza Naguib
official: 官方在线 2020-08-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Life expectancy for Blacks is about 8 year shorter than for Whites. A shorter life expectancy, in line with the theoretical prediction of a simple model, determines a much lower amount of savings and wealth accumulation and therefore a lower degree of insurance. This, in turn, contributes to persistent racial differentials in life-cycle consumption. Starting from the same position in the consumption distribution Blacks end up in a lower percentile than Whites after a few decades. This is particularly marked for those Blacks who start at the top of the consumption distribution, where Whites are much more persistent. We document these facts using 40 years of PSID data (1981-2017).
abstract_zh: 黑人的预期寿命比白人短约8年。较短的预期寿命，与一个简单模型的理论预测相符，决定了储蓄和财富积累水平显著降低，从而保险程度也较低。这反过来又导致生命周期消费中持续存在的种族差异。从消费分布的同一位置出发，几十年后黑人最终所处的百分位低于白人。这一现象在那些起始于消费分布顶端的黑人中尤为显著，而白人在该位置上的持续性则强得多。我们利用40年的PSID数据（1981-2017年）记录了这些事实。

title: Heterogeneous predictability on mutual fund alphas: A sparse clustering GMM approach
title_zh: 共同基金阿尔法的异质性可预测性：一种稀疏聚类GMM方法
title_primary: 共同基金阿尔法的异质性可预测性：一种稀疏聚类GMM方法
title_secondary: Heterogeneous predictability on mutual fund alphas: A sparse clustering GMM approach
authors: Liyuan Cui, Guanhao Feng, Jiangshan Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Mutual fund managers' skills, measured by risk-adjusted alphas, are predictable using fund characteristics identified by machine learning (e.g., Kaniel et al., 2023, JFE; DeMiguel et al., 2023, JFE). However, alpha's predictive power varies across funds and periods, with most funds exhibiting negligible alphas. To model this heterogeneous predictability, this paper introduces Sparse Clustering GMM, a nonparametric approach for uncovering latent fund groups. SCGMM clusters funds using estimated alphas and identifies group-specific parameters tied to market predictors. The method accounts for heterogeneity in cross-sectional grouping and time-varying mechanisms across predictors, without requiring prior cluster information or time-varying specifications. We establish consistency for group recovery and time-varying parameter estimation. Empirically, using monthly U.S. mutual fund data, we find that predictable alpha is concentrated in a small subset of funds, with the majority of funds exhibiting near-zero, weakly predictable alphas. The skilled clusters also exhibit lower benchmark R^2, moderate expense ratios, and longer manager tenure.
abstract_zh: 共同基金经理的技能，以风险调整后的阿尔法衡量，可通过机器学习识别的基金特征进行预测（例如，Kaniel等，2023，JFE；DeMiguel等，2023，JFE）。然而，阿尔法的预测能力在不同基金和时期之间存在差异，大多数基金的阿尔法接近于零。为建模这种异质性预测，本文引入了稀疏聚类GMM，一种用于识别潜在基金组的非参数方法。SCGMM利用估计的阿尔法对基金进行聚类，并识别与市场预测因子相关的组特定参数。该方法考虑了横截面分组中的异质性以及预测因子间随时间变化的机制，无需先验聚类信息或时变设定。我们建立了组恢复和时变参数估计的一致性。实证上，利用美国月度共同基金数据，我们发现可预测的阿尔法集中于一小部分基金，而大多数基金表现出接近零、弱可预测的阿尔法。技能较高的聚类还表现出较低的基准R²、适中的费用比率和更长的经理任期。

title: Migration, Segregation, and Interracial Marriage
title_zh: 迁移、隔离与跨种族婚姻
title_primary: 迁移、隔离与跨种族婚姻
title_secondary: Migration, Segregation, and Interracial Marriage
authors: Cameron Deal
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Interracial marriage increased substantially in the late 20th century, concurrently with declines in regional and residential segregation. This paper studies whether these trends are related using two historical quasiexperiments and a stylized model of the marriage market. I use a shift-share instrument to find that the Great Migration increased interracial marriage in receiving communities, though this effect was absent in highly segregated cities. Using railroad density as an instrument, I also find that residential segregation decreased interracial marriage. Together, these findings indicate that internal migration and declining segregation contributed to the rise of interracial marriage in the non-Southern United States.
abstract_zh: 摘要 20世纪末，跨种族婚姻显著增加，与此同时，区域和居住隔离现象有所减少。本文通过两个历史准实验和一个婚姻市场的简化模型，探讨这些趋势是否相互关联。我采用份额转移工具发现，大迁徙增加了接收社区的跨种族婚姻，但在高度隔离的城市中这一效应并不存在。利用铁路密度作为工具变量，我还发现居住隔离降低了跨种族婚姻的发生率。综合这些发现，表明内部迁移和隔离程度的下降促进了美国非南部地区跨种族婚姻的兴起。

title: Organizational Capacity and Project Dynamics,
title_zh: 组织能力与项目动态
title_primary: 组织能力与项目动态
title_secondary: Organizational Capacity and Project Dynamics,
authors: Dana Foarta, Michael M Ting
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Organizational capacity is widely considered central to whether managers or politicians can deliver complex projects in an efficient manner. Yet in practice performance can depend on the interaction of capacity with a host of factors such as political opposition or regulatory constraints. We develop a dynamic theory of project development that examines these interactions. In the model, higher capacity enables faster progress toward completion, but opposing interests may incur costly delays by attempting to revise the distribution of project payoffs. Project designers can avoid revisions by equalizing distributive benefits or inflating project scales to make delays prohibitively costly. We show that welfare is minimized when both capacity and the ability to revise are moderate. More efficient outcomes are either smaller than socially optimal or have highly unequal distributive outcomes.
abstract_zh: 组织能力被广泛视为管理者或政治家能否高效交付复杂项目的核心要素。然而，在实践中，绩效可能取决于能力与政治反对或监管约束等多种因素的相互作用。我们构建了一个项目开发的动态理论，以考察这些相互作用。在该模型中，更高的能力能加速项目向完成推进，但反对利益方可能通过试图修订项目收益分配来造成代价高昂的延误。项目设计者可以通过均衡分配收益或扩大项目规模使延误成本过高，从而避免修订。我们证明，当能力和修订能力均处于中等水平时，社会福利最小化。更有效的结果要么规模小于社会最优，要么分配结果高度不均。

title: Taxes and Transfers with Nonlinear Wage Dynamics
title_zh: 非线性工资动态下的税收与转移支付
title_primary: 非线性工资动态下的税收与转移支付
title_secondary: Taxes and Transfers with Nonlinear Wage Dynamics
authors: Nezih Guner, Eugenio Renedo, Emre Enes Yavuz
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how the specification of wage risk in quantitative life-cycle models changes the welfare evaluation of taxes and transfers. We estimate four wage processes: a canonical linear process; a flexible nonlinear process with age dependence, non-normality, and state-dependent persistence; and two intermediate processes. Comparisons across the four isolate the role of each feature: age dependence, non-normality, and nonlinear persistence. The estimated processes imply different allocations of wage risk across permanent, persistent, and transitory components: the richer processes assign less risk to short-lived transitory shocks and more to long-lived permanent and persistent components. We embed each process in the same incomplete-markets life-cycle economy with endogenous labor supply. Removing federal tax progressivity and means-tested transfers raises mean welfare by $0.72%$ of lifetime consumption under the nonlinear process but lowers it by $0.47%$ under the non-normal process. These welfare differences reflect both the total amount of wage risk and its allocation across permanent heterogeneity, persistent shocks, and transitory shocks. Holding this amount and allocation fixed, non-normal shocks create rare but severe low-income states that increase the value of public insurance, while the state-dependent mean reversion that characterizes the nonlinear specification works in the opposite direction: unusually bad persistent states tend to be undone by subsequent favorable shocks, so the wage process partly insures itself, and that lowers the value of public insurance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了定量生命周期模型中工资风险设定如何改变税收与转移支付的福利评估。我们估计了四种工资过程：一种典型线性过程；一种包含年龄依赖性、非正态性和状态依赖持续性的灵活非线性过程；以及两种中间过程。通过四种过程的比较，我们隔离了各特征的作用：年龄依赖性、非正态性和非线性持续性。估计出的过程在永久性、持续性和暂时性成分之间分配工资风险的方式不同：更丰富的过程将较少风险分配给短期暂时性冲击，而将更多风险分配给长期永久性和持续性成分。我们将每种过程嵌入同一具有内生劳动供给的不完全市场生命周期经济中。在非线性过程下，取消联邦税收累进性和基于经济状况调查的转移支付使平均福利提高终身消费的$0.72\%$，但在非正态过程下则降低$0.47\%$。这些福利差异既反映了工资风险的总量，也反映了其在永久性异质性、持续性冲击和暂时性冲击之间的分配。在保持总量和分配不变的情况下，非正态冲击创造了罕见但严重的低收入状态，增加了公共保险的价值；而表征非线性设定的状态依赖性均值回归则起相反作用：异常糟糕的持续性状态往往被随后的有利冲击所抵消，因此工资过程部分自我保险，这降低了公共保险的价值。

title: Synergies or Trade‐Offs Between Environmental and Economic Outcomes? An Analysis of Agricultural Production Performance
title_zh: 环境与经济成果之间的协同还是权衡？农业生产绩效分析
title_primary: 环境与经济成果之间的协同还是权衡？农业生产绩效分析
title_secondary: Synergies or Trade‐Offs Between Environmental and Economic Outcomes? An Analysis of Agricultural Production Performance
authors: Wenhui Zhang, Xinli Ke, Vivian Wei Huang
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Incorporating greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions as an undesirable output of agricultural production in a directional distance function provides a better understanding of agricultural production performance. Based on balanced panel data from 126 prefecture‐level regions in the Yangtze River Basin in China, we employed a quadratic directional output‐oriented distance function to measure agricultural production performance in terms of environmental efficiency, relative shadow price of GHG emissions and Morishima elasticities of substitution between inputs. We found an upward trend, with average environmental efficiency of 0.871 during 2000–2020. This indicates that 12.9% more agricultural added value can be achieved, along with a 12.9% reduction in GHG emissions. Agricultural production in the upstream Yangtze River Basin region showed the best performance in terms of environmental efficiency. The estimated relative shadow price of GHG emissions was 4.606 and showed a negative association with environmental efficiency. Morishima elasticities of substitution indicated a substitution relationship of labour and fertiliser to land, and a strong complementary relationship between fertiliser and labour.
abstract_zh: 将温室气体排放作为农业生产非期望产出纳入方向性距离函数，有助于更深入理解农业生产绩效。基于中国长江流域126个地级市2000-2020年的平衡面板数据，采用二次型方向性产出距离函数，从环境效率、温室气体排放相对影子价格及投入要素间Morishima替代弹性三个维度测度农业生产绩效。研究发现：样本期间平均环境效率为0.871且呈上升趋势，表明在实现12.9%农业增加值增长的同时可同步减少12.9%的温室气体排放；长江上游地区农业生产的环境效率表现最优；温室气体排放相对影子价格估计值为4.606，且与环境效率呈负相关关系；Morishima替代弹性显示劳动力和化肥对土地存在替代关系，而化肥与劳动力之间呈现强互补关系。

title: Are mass layoffs individually costly but socially beneficial?
title_zh: 大规模裁员是否对个人代价高昂但对社会有益？
title_primary: 大规模裁员是否对个人代价高昂但对社会有益？
title_secondary: Are mass layoffs individually costly but socially beneficial?
authors: Axelle Arquié, Thomas Grjebine
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper reexamines the consequences of mass layoffs in the French manufacturing sector by linking individual displacement costs to broader local labor-market outcomes. Using matched employer–employee data from 1995 to 2019 and a unified definition of mass layoffs, it provides the first joint assessment of their individual and aggregate effects. Displaced workers experience large and persistent employment and earnings losses. At the local level, unemployment and the number of job seekers rise sharply and remain elevated for several years, with a large local employment multiplier. Two mechanisms connect individual losses to aggregate outcomes: a demand channel, whereby larger wage losses among displaced workers amplify local unemployment, and a housing-related mobility channel linking local housing market conditions to workers’ geographic mobility. Worker reallocations themselves appear inefficient: displaced high-quality workers become less likely to match with high-productivity establishments, while destination firms display lower investment rates and lower value added. We also uncover a critical measurement bias affecting labor productivity assessments. Under standard accounting conventions — where temporary agency workers and their value added are recorded in the service sector rather than in the manufacturing establishments where they actually work — mass layoffs appear to raise productivity. Correcting for this bias fully reverses this apparent productivity gain and instead reveals a substantial productivity decline. Overall, mass layoffs appear individually and socially costly.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将个体置换成本与更广泛的本地劳动力市场结果相联系，重新审视了法国制造业部门大规模裁员的后果。利用1995年至2019年的匹配雇主-雇员数据，并采用统一的大规模裁员定义，本文首次对其个体与总体效应进行了联合评估。被置换的工人经历了巨大且持续的就业和收入损失。在地方层面，失业率和求职者数量急剧上升，并在数年内保持高位，同时存在显著的本地就业乘数效应。两种机制将个体损失与总体结果联系起来：一是需求渠道，即被置换工人更大的工资损失加剧了本地失业；二是与住房相关的流动性渠道，将本地住房市场条件与工人的地理流动性相联系。工人自身的重新配置似乎效率低下：被置换的高质量工人与高生产率企业匹配的可能性降低，而目的地企业则表现出较低的投资率和增加值。我们还揭示了一个影响劳动生产率评估的关键测量偏差。在标准会计惯例下——即临时机构工人及其增加值被记录在服务部门，而非其实际工作的制造业机构中——大规模裁员看似提高了生产率。纠正这一偏差后，这一表面上的生产率提升完全逆转，反而揭示了显著的生产率下降。总体而言，大规模裁员在个体层面和社会层面均代价高昂。

title: Social Preferences and Redistributive Politics
title_zh: 社会偏好与再分配政治
title_primary: 社会偏好与再分配政治
title_secondary: Social Preferences and Redistributive Politics
authors: Ernst Fehr, Thomas Epper, Julien Senn
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the link between social preferences and a behaviorally validated measure of support for redistribution. We uncover three fundamentally distinct social preference types: predominantly selfish, inequality averse, and altruistic individuals. Inequality averse and altruistic individuals display a much stronger support for redistribution, particularly if they are more affluent. Beliefs about the role of effort and luck for success play no role for selfish individuals but are highly relevant for other-regarding individuals. Finally, while inequality averse individuals display strong support for policies aimed at reducing the incomes of the rich, altruistic individuals are considerably less supportive of these policies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了社会偏好与行为验证的再分配支持度之间的关联。研究发现三种根本不同的社会偏好类型：主要自私型、不平等厌恶型和利他型个体。不平等厌恶型和利他型个体对再分配表现出显著更强的支持，尤其是当这些个体本身较为富裕时。关于努力与运气在成功中作用的信念对自私型个体毫无影响，但对关注他人型个体高度相关。最后，尽管不平等厌恶型个体强烈支持旨在削减富人收入的政策，利他型个体对这些政策的支持度则明显较低。

title: Does South–South Cooperation Deliver? The Economic Impacts of BRICS Plus Platform
title_zh: 南南合作是否有效？金砖+平台的经济影响
title_primary: 南南合作是否有效？金砖+平台的经济影响
title_secondary: Does South–South Cooperation Deliver? The Economic Impacts of BRICS Plus Platform
authors: Ya Tan, Peng Ma, Qingxin Lan, Yutong Ji, Fangyuan Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates whether South–South cooperation delivers tangible economic benefits by examining the impact of the BRICS Plus platform on the economic development of participating countries. Using national‐level panel data for 125 countries from 2009 to 2022 and applying a staggered Difference‐in‐Differences approach, we find that BRICS Plus participation is associated with an average annual GDP per capita growth rate increase of approximately 3.42% compared to non‐participating countries on the same continent. Mechanism analysis suggests that the positive effect is driven by enhanced foreign direct investment, improvements in trade balances, and expanded financing channels, with India and China playing leading roles through investment, and South Africa contributing through regional financing. Participation is also linked to improved governance and reductions in civil conflicts but shows no significant increase in aid inflows from other international organizations. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the positive economic effects are concentrated in Asian and African countries, among low‐ and lower‐middle‐income economies with higher agricultural shares, and in countries with stronger initial infrastructure. Overall, the results provide empirical support for the developmental potential of institutionalized South–South cooperation through platforms like BRICS Plus.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察金砖+平台对参与国经济发展的影响，探究南南合作是否带来切实的经济效益。基于2009至2022年间125个国家的跨国面板数据，采用交错双重差分法，我们发现：相较于同大洲的非参与国，金砖+参与国的年均人均GDP增长率约提高3.42%。机制分析表明，这一积极效应源于外国直接投资增长、贸易平衡改善及融资渠道拓宽——其中印度和中国通过投资发挥引领作用，南非则通过区域融资作出贡献。参与金砖+还与治理水平提升及国内冲突减少相关，但未显著增加其他国际组织的援助流入。异质性分析显示，积极经济效应集中于亚洲和非洲国家、农业占比较高的低收入及中低收入经济体，以及初始基础设施较完善的国家。总体而言，本研究为通过金砖+等平台实现制度化的南南合作的发展潜力提供了实证支持。

title: Benefit-Based Taxation can Include Substantial Redistribution
title_zh: 基于受益的税收可以包含显著的再分配
title_primary: 基于受益的税收可以包含显著的再分配
title_secondary: Benefit-Based Taxation can Include Substantial Redistribution
authors: Jo Ellery, Matthew C. Weinzierl
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Contrary to a long-standing concern, we present evidence that classical benefit-based labor income taxation in the tradition of Smith (1776) is consistent with income redistribution through transfers and negative average tax rates both theoretically and---in plausibly-specified simulations---quantitatively at levels which reflect U.S. policy over the past several decades. As redistribution is widespread in practice, our results remove an obstacle to the benefit principle’s plausibility as a prevailing normative foundation of tax policy.
abstract_zh: 与长期以来的担忧相反，我们提供的证据表明，遵循斯密（1776）传统的经典受益型劳动收入税，在理论上与通过转移支付和负平均税率实现的收入再分配是一致的，并且在合理设定的模拟中，其量化水平也反映了美国过去几十年的政策实践。由于再分配在实践中普遍存在，我们的研究结果消除了受益原则作为税收政策主流规范基础可信性的一大障碍。

title: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk and Moral Hazard
title_zh: 次优世界中的最优洪水保险：财政溢出效应、重分类风险与道德风险
title_primary: 次优世界中的最优洪水保险：财政溢出效应、重分类风险与道德风险
title_secondary: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk and Moral Hazard
authors: Jonathan Gruber, Adam Solomon
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 52%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.
abstract_zh: 气候变化加剧使得防范自然灾害风险——无论是通过事前保险还是事后援助——成为首要公共政策问题。美国传统的洪水风险防范体系以联邦紧急事务管理局（FEMA）的事后援助和国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）的高额补贴保险为特征。为纠正补贴导致的洪泛区过度建设与减灾不足问题，NFIP近期转向精算公平保费。但这一改革产生了两项非预期后果：一是随着洪泛区保险覆盖率下降，FEMA灾害援助产生财政溢出效应；二是家庭面临因气候预测不确定性导致的不可保重分类风险。我们构建了最优洪水保险模型，将保费补贴的静态与动态权衡纳入分析框架。随后采用多种识别策略与数据，估算实施该模型所需的五个关键参数。研究发现，财政溢出效应与重分类风险保护带来的收益显著超过道德风险成本，最优洪水保险补贴率为52%，与改革前的补贴水平相当。

title: Arsenic and fertility: Evidence from the 1900 English beer-poisoning epidemic
title_zh: 砷与生育力：来自1900年英国啤酒中毒流行病的证据
title_primary: 砷与生育力：来自1900年英国啤酒中毒流行病的证据
title_secondary: Arsenic and fertility: Evidence from the 1900 English beer-poisoning epidemic
authors: Jonathan James
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In 1900, thousands of people in England were poisoned by arsenic. The source was beer contaminated by tainted sugar. This paper examines how the poisoning affected birth rates in the affected areas, using an event study difference-in-difference design. The results show that the arsenic-in-beer epidemic caused a 10% drop in births in 1901, but the effect was short-lived. After about 28 weeks, birth rates returned to pre-epidemic levels. Evidence from the timing of the effect and a range of alternative mechanisms is most consistent with the epidemic reducing conceptions or early pregnancies, rather than operating through economic disruption or later gestational harm.
abstract_zh: 1900年，英格兰数千人因砷中毒而受害，其源头为被污染糖所掺杂的啤酒。本文采用事件研究双重差分设计，探讨了此次中毒事件对受影响地区出生率的影响。结果显示，1901年啤酒砷中毒疫情导致出生率下降10%，但此效应短暂，约28周后，出生率恢复至疫情前水平。基于效应时间点及一系列替代机制的证据，最符合的解释是疫情减少了受孕或早期妊娠，而非通过经济干扰或妊娠后期伤害发挥作用。

title: How Serious Are Experimenter Demand Effects? Evidence and Mitigation Strategies
title_zh: 实验者需求效应有多严重？证据与缓解策略
title_primary: 实验者需求效应有多严重？证据与缓解策略
title_secondary: How Serious Are Experimenter Demand Effects? Evidence and Mitigation Strategies
authors: Jonathan de Quidt, Lise Vesterlund, Alistair Wilson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Experimenter demand effects arise when participants in an experiment or survey distort their behavior in a misguided attempt to please the experimenter by confirming their research hypothesis. Experimental economists have taken the threat of demand effects seriously and have developed an array of best practices to mitigate their influence, as well as bounding techniques to assess their potential impact on inference. We provide an overview of these techniques and summarize recent empirical assessments of the potential threat of experimenter demand. Our main message is that good design is normally sufficient to address demand concerns, and that bounding approaches work well when concerns remain. Existing empirical evidence suggests that the potential impact of experimenter demand is limited.
abstract_zh: 实验者需求效应是指实验或调查中的参与者为迎合实验者、证实其研究假设，在误导性动机驱使下扭曲自身行为。实验经济学家高度重视需求效应的威胁，已发展出一系列最佳实践方法以减轻其影响，并建立了边界评估技术以衡量其对推断的潜在影响。本文系统梳理了这些技术方法，并总结了近期关于实验者需求潜在威胁的实证评估。我们的核心观点是：良好的实验设计通常足以应对需求效应问题，而当疑虑依然存在时，边界评估方法能有效发挥作用。现有实证证据表明，实验者需求的潜在影响是有限的。

title: More Powerful Cluster Randomized Controlled Trials
title_zh: 更强大的整群随机对照试验
title_primary: 更强大的整群随机对照试验
title_secondary: More Powerful Cluster Randomized Controlled Trials
authors: Brendon McConnell, Marcos Vera-Hernández
official: 官方在线 2025-11-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Balanced experimental designs, in which the number of treatment and control units are the same, do not maximize power subject to a cost constraint when treatment units are more expensive than control ones. Despite this, such balanced designs are the norm in economics. This paper describes methods to optimally choose the number of treatment and control clusters, and the number of units within treatment and control clusters, allowing for full flexibility. We use three archetypal examples from the development literature to illustrate the magnitude of the power gains, which lie between 7.9 and 19.0 percentage points.
abstract_zh: 当处理组单位成本高于对照组时，平衡实验设计（即处理组与对照组单位数量相等）在成本约束下无法实现统计功效最大化。然而，此类平衡设计仍是经济学研究的常态。本文提出在完全灵活条件下，最优选择处理组与对照组集群数量及其内部单位数量的方法。我们采用发展经济学文献中的三个典型案例，展示统计功效的提升幅度介于7.9至19.0个百分点之间。

title: Parental paternalism and patience
title_zh: 家长式父权与耐心
title_primary: 家长式父权与耐心
title_secondary: Parental paternalism and patience
authors: Lukas Kiessling, Shyamal Chowdhury, Hannah Schildberg-Hörisch, Matthias Sutter
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2021-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Quantitative evidence on the extent of paternalism within families is scant. We provide a novel measure to study whether and how parents interfere paternalistically in their children’s intertemporal decision-making. In an experiment with over 2000 members from 610 families in Bangladesh, we find that more than half of all parents are willing to pay money to override their children’s choices in order to mitigate the (correctly anticipated) level of children’s present bias. The extent of parental paternalism is strongly related to parenting styles and we discuss how it interacts with the intergenerational transmission of patience.
abstract_zh: 关于家庭内部家长主义程度的定量证据十分匮乏。我们提出了一种新颖的衡量方法，用以研究父母是否以及如何以家长主义方式干预子女的跨期决策。通过对孟加拉国610个家庭中2000多名成员进行的实验，我们发现超过半数的父母愿意支付金钱来推翻子女的选择，以减轻子女（被正确预期的）现时偏向程度。父母家长主义的程度与教养方式密切相关，我们进一步探讨了其如何与耐心的代际传递相互作用。
